about: The everyday eval's stand-in web (6b651): INVENTED results, dated around 2026-11-11, so no eval or test asks a real search engine from this Mac (the engines flagged its connection). A query holding every word of a group's `match` gets that group's rows; anything else finds nothing, which measures the no-results path (the bitcoin question is left out on purpose). Pages are what the reader 'fetches'.

rows.title: Knicks 118, Bulls 109: Brunson scores 34 as New York pulls away late - ESPN
rows.body: Jalen Brunson scored 34 points and Karl-Anthony Towns added 22 points and 13 rebounds as the New York Knicks beat the Chicago Bulls 118-109 on Tuesday night at Madison Square Garden. The Knicks improved to 7-4.

rows.title: Knicks schedule 2026-27 - NBA.com
rows.body: Next: Thursday, Nov. 13 vs. Boston Celtics, 7:30 PM ET, MSG. Last: Tue, Nov. 11 W 118-109 vs. Chicago.

rows.title: Senate passes stopgap funding bill, averting a shutdown through January - AP News
rows.body: The Senate voted 71-28 late Tuesday to keep the government funded through Jan. 30, sending the bill to the president.

rows.title: Veterans Day: ceremonies at Arlington and across the country - Reuters
rows.body: Americans mark Veterans Day on Wednesday with ceremonies at Arlington National Cemetery and parades in New York and other cities.

rows.title: COP31 climate talks open in Antalya with finance fight front and center - Reuters
rows.body: Delegates from nearly 200 countries opened two weeks of UN climate talks in Antalya, Turkey, on Monday, with adaptation finance the main dispute.

rows.title: Stocks edge higher as investors await Thursday's inflation report - CNBC
rows.body: The S&P 500 rose 0.3% on Tuesday; the October consumer price index is due Thursday.

rows.title: New movies in theaters this weekend (Nov. 14): what to see - Vulture
rows.body: Opening Friday, Nov. 14: 'The Long Walk Home', a family drama starring Florence Pugh; 'Night Shift 2', the horror sequel; and the animated 'Pip and the Paper Moon'. Still strong in its third weekend: 'Overland', the Western with Austin Butler.

rows.title: L train service status - MTA
rows.body: L trains are running with good service on Wednesday, Nov. 11. Planned work: this weekend (Sat-Sun, Nov. 14-15), no L trains between Broadway Junction and Canarsie; free shuttle buses replace them.
